subject: FW: FinBank throughput spike — plan to preserve audit evidence
messages:
From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@finbank.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@finbank.com
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Severe latency + errors during settlement window — need audit-ready logs

Chloe,

We experienced a significant spike during the 03/01 settlement window: sustained 4–6s tail latencies for token generation and a ~8% 5xx error rate for the payment-validation route. This impacted settlement batching and caused retries on our side. Our security/compliance team is preparing for an external audit next week and they will require chain-of-custody-ready evidence for the period 2027-03-01 08:45–10:15 PST.

We need:
- Request 1: All request/response logs, traces, and sampling IDs for the timeframe above.
- Request 2: Any server-side metrics showing CPU/GPU contention, queue depth, and KV cache evictions.
- Request 3: Confirmation that logs will be preserved unchanged (hashing + immutable storage) for audit review.

Please advise your plan and expected delivery timeline ASAP — auditors want to pre-stage evidence.

Thanks,
Maria Lopez
Head of Platform Reliability, FinBank
maria.lopez@finbank.com
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@finbank.com>
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 09:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Severe latency + errors during settlement window — need audit-ready logs

Hi Maria — thanks for the heads up and the specific timeframe.

We're on it. Immediate plan (high-level):
- Confirm scope with you (I’ll reply with the exact time range to be pulled).
- Snapshot telemetry and trace IDs, store as an immutable evidence bundle, and provide a manifest + SHA256 hashes.
- Deliver an initial set of artifacts (sample traces + metrics) within 24 hours; full bundle for audit within 72 hours.

As a first step, can you confirm whether auditors need raw payloads (you should indicate this explicitly) or redacted records are acceptable? If raw payloads are required we’ll coordinate with Legal on an access plan.

I’ve looped in Marcus and Rishi for the telemetry pull and Laura for legal/retention requirements.

—Chloe
Chloe Martin
Account Lead, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 09:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Severe latency + errors during settlement window — telemetry snapshot attached

Chloe / Maria,

I pulled an initial telemetry snapshot for 2027-03-01 08:30–10:30 PST: attached sample CSV with per-route p50/p95/p99, request counts, and 5xx rates (telemetry_spike_20270301.csv).
Also attached is a list of trace IDs we recorded that overlap with the error spike (trace_ids_20270301.txt).

Prelim notes:
- Root cause signal looks like queue saturation on the dedicated inference pool that was handling FinBank's high-concurrency settlement bursts; we saw backpressure to the fronting router which increased tail latency and triggered error cascades.
- KV cache eviction rate increased ~3x during the window for the model variants used by your payment route — contributed to extra per-request work.

I will create an evidence bundle and place it in an immutable S3 bucket with object lock enabled, generate SHA256 hashes, and publish an evidence_manifest file. ETA: initial bundle ready within 6–10 hours; full artifact set within 48–72 hours.

Attachments: telemetry_spike_20270301.csv (sample), trace_ids_20270301.txt

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Incident Response Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 10:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Preservation & chain-of-custody — guidance

Team,

Legal/compliance note for evidence handling:
- Do NOT modify original log files. Pull an immutable copy and record the source object path, timestamp, and a SHA256 digest for each file.
- Store artifacts in the incident S3 bucket with Object Lock (governance) enabled and set retention to 180 days unless FinBank requests otherwise.
- Maintain an evidence_manifest.txt that lists every file, its source, capture timestamp, and SHA256. Attach the manifest to any delivery to the customer or auditors.
- For any raw payloads that include PII, we need a joint access agreement with FinBank and an auditable access log. Do not grant raw payload access until signed agreement is in place.
- If auditors request a notarized chain-of-custody, coordinate with Security to produce signed attestations.

I recommend we prepare two bundles: (A) redacted logs + metadata/metrics (deliver within 24h), (B) raw logs under escrow / gated access (deliver only after agreement).

—Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@finbank.com>
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com, evelyn.hart@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 08:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Preservation & delivery plan — FinBank evidence (action items)

Maria — following up with the plan we discussed internally and the attachments we will deliver: see evidence_manifest_20270302.txt in the bundle.

Planned deliverables:
1) Within 12 hours: redacted bundle (metrics, per-request latencies, sample traces, trace IDs) + evidence_manifest_20270302.txt + SHA256 hashes (preservation_hashes_20270302.sha256).
2) Within 48–72 hours: full artifact bundle placed into an immutable S3 hold (Object Lock) and a QA’ed manifest. We will not release raw payloads until we have a signed joint-access agreement from FinBank and Legal sign-off.

Please confirm whether redacted artifacts are sufficient for the auditors to start their pre-work. If they require raw request/response bodies, advise and we’ll initiate the escrow/agreement flow.

Call to action: confirm by 11:00 PST today if redacted bundle is acceptable; otherwise we’ll pause and start the formal gated access steps.

—Chloe
From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@finbank.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@finbank.com
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 17:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Preservation & delivery plan — FinBank evidence (action items)

Chloe / team — thanks for the quick coordination and for separating redacted vs raw deliverables. Redacted bundle is fine to start the auditors; they will request full payloads only if their sampling requires deeper dives.

Please go ahead with the redacted bundle now and confirm when the immutable S3 location and manifest are available (we’ll need the object paths and SHA256 hashes for our records). We will follow up on the joint access agreement for raw payloads — FinBank legal will reach out.

Appreciate the expedited support.

—Maria
